scope: Reusable per-realization distributional metric definitions for candidate and pinned FLEXPART 11.1 outputs: what each metric means, which evidence it needs, how it is extracted and how it is represented in the evaluation report. The contract defines no thresholds, ensemble statistics, confidence intervals, equivalence margins or PASS/FAIL verdicts (#58/#59 and the physics issues own those). A computed metric never establishes input equivalence (#52), execution provenance (#53), deterministic invariants (#54) or scientific equivalence.

record_statuses.COMPUTED: Required evidence is present, structurally valid and compatible; value holds every declared output (an output may be null only where its definition says so).
record_statuses.DEGENERATE: Evidence is valid but the metric is mathematically undefined for it (zero total weight, zero variance, zero denominator, empty footprint). value is null; no substitute such as 0, 1, the domain center or (0,0,0) is reported.
record_statuses.MISSING_EVIDENCE: A required artifact or field (particle dump, particle masses, gridded field, deposition reservoir, layer geometry) is absent. Never reconstructed from another representation.
record_statuses.INCOMPATIBLE: Paired or reference-dependent evidence differs in grid, units, quantity, species, window, vertical reference, weighting, transformation or contract version. No value is computed over incompatible domains.
record_statuses.BLOCKED: Paired prerequisites are not established: #52 input equivalence, #53 execution binding or a PASS #54 deterministic-invariant aggregate. value is null.
record_statuses.INTEGRITY_ERROR: Evidence is malformed: non-finite or negative weights, invalid coordinates, wrong weight units, incomplete fields, a negative covariance eigenvalue beyond roundoff, a mutated artifact hash or mixed execution provenance.
record_statuses.UNSUPPORTED: The metric is defined but no attributable evidence source or validated output semantics exist yet; the named follow-up owns it.

weightings.particle_mass_kg: Each active particle weighs its declared mass in kg (the artifact must declare kg). Zero-mass particles carry no weight.
weightings.particle_count: Each active particle weighs 1, independent of mass. Used where particle masses are not decoded (oracle partposit) or as an explicit count-distribution metric. Never presented as mass weighting.
weightings.cell_mass_proportional: Each output cell weighs a quantity proportional to its mass: value*volume (per_volume fields), value*area (per_area fields) or value (per_cell fields). Volumes/areas use the FLEXPART outgrid_mod.f90 latitude-zone area (scripts/evaluate/io_gpu.py:cell_volume_m3) and OUTHEIGHTS thicknesses. Scale-invariant metrics only; never a kilogram total.
weightings.cell_sample_unweighted: Every aligned cell is one equally weighted sample of the native field values (not area- or volume-weighted).
weightings.none: Ledger value read from an authoritative record; no weighting applies.

air_concentration.meaning: Airborne species amount on the 3-D output grid over the declared window (time average for FLEXPART grid_conc, which uses factor3d=1e12/volume/outnum in binary_output_mod.f90).

dry_deposition.meaning: Dry-deposited species amount on the surface output grid. FLEXPART 11.1 binary output writes 1e12*drygrid/area (binary_output_mod.f90:1233), accumulated since simulation start (drygridunc is reset only at allocation, outgrid_mod.f90:344).

wet_deposition.meaning: Wet-deposited species amount on the surface output grid. FLEXPART 11.1 binary output writes sp_fact*1e12*wetgrid/area (binary_output_mod.f90:1200), accumulated since simulation start.

particle_ensemble.meaning: Active particle end-state positions and weights of one realization.

mass_ledger.meaning: Kilogram mass budget reservoirs of the #54 INV-MASS-CLOSURE record.

field_layouts.ix_iy_iz: Flat index ((ix*ny)+iy)*nz+iz (io_fortran.read_grid_conc_blocks concentration, candidate gridded JSON).
field_layouts.x_fastest_2d: Flat index ix+iy*nx (FLEXPART native surface order, io_fortran.read_grid_conc_blocks wet/dry blocks).

coordinate_references.horizontal: geographic_lon_lat_degrees. Horizontal distances use the equirectangular local-tangent projection about the weighted mean latitude with R=6371000 m (metrics.local_tangent_offsets_km, identical to src/bin/corpus-run.rs). Ensembles spanning more than 180 degrees of longitude or a global output grid are UNSUPPORTED (LONGITUDE_WRAP_UNSUPPORTED); longitudes are never averaged across the wrap.

vertical.agl: Metres above ground level. Candidate Particle.pos_z (src/particles/mod.rs) and FLEXPART ztra1 / OUTHEIGHTS are AGL.
vertical.rule: A vertical metric is extracted only when its coordinate reference is declared; layer metrics require the layer reference to equal the height reference; comparability keys carry the reference so AGL and ASL values are never grouped.

permitted_transformations.identity: The only permitted grid transformation in v1. Paired gridded metrics require identical grids (report.check_grid_alignment, tolerance GRID_ABS_TOL) and identical vertical geometry.
permitted_transformations.regridding: UNAVAILABLE. No validated conservative mapping exists in the evaluator; differing grids yield INCOMPATIBLE/REGRIDDING_UNAVAILABLE, and a field declaring any non-identity transformation yields INCOMPATIBLE/NONCONSERVATIVE_TRANSFORMATION. A conservative mapping must be introduced and versioned by its own issue (source/target grid identity, algorithm version, conservation check, area/volume weights, mapped-artifact hashes) before this contract can permit it.

prerequisites.unary: Extracted only from realizations that passed the evaluator's fail-closed #53 artifact verification and have no #54 INTEGRITY_ERROR (the evaluator stops before extraction otherwise). Each record carries its realization's #54 verdict; a unary value never proves input equivalence or parity.
prerequisites.paired: Computed only when the #54 aggregate verdict is PASS and deterministic_invariants.paired_scoring.status is ELIGIBLE (#52 INPUT_EQUIVALENT plus #53 binding of every realization), after compatibility holds. Otherwise status BLOCKED with value null. A #54 FAIL can never be offset by distributional values.
prerequisites.scoring_eligibility: Every record carries eligible_for_paired_scoring = (status COMPUTED) and (#54 aggregate PASS) and (paired_scoring ELIGIBLE). #58/#59 must ignore records where it is false.

metrics.meaning: Weighted horizontal centroid of the active particle ensemble.
required_artifacts: candidate corpus seed_*.json particles (lon_deg, lat_deg, mass_kg)
metrics.aggregation_domain: all active particles of one realization
metrics.time_window: instantaneous end state at the case integration end
metrics.normalization: weights divided by their total
metrics.missing_data: MISSING_EVIDENCE/PARTICLE_DUMP_UNAVAILABLE without positions; PARTICLE_MASS_UNAVAILABLE for particle_mass_kg without decoded masses
metrics.degenerate: DEGENERATE/ZERO_TOTAL_WEIGHT when the total weight is zero

metrics.meaning: Weighted mean particle height in the declared vertical reference.
required_artifacts: particle heights with a declared vertical reference
metrics.aggregation_domain: all active particles of one realization
metrics.time_window: instantaneous end state at the case integration end
metrics.normalization: weights divided by their total
metrics.missing_data: MISSING_EVIDENCE when heights are absent; INTEGRITY_ERROR/INVALID_COORDINATE for non-finite or negative AGL heights

metrics.meaning: Weighted population covariance of east/north particle offsets about the weighted centroid.
metrics.aggregation_domain: all active particles of one realization
metrics.normalization: population convention: sums divided by total weight (not N-1)
metrics.degenerate: DEGENERATE/ZERO_TOTAL_WEIGHT; a single particle gives an all-zero matrix (COMPUTED)

metrics.meaning: Eigen-decomposition of particle.horizontal.covariance: major/minor variances, axis spreads and major-axis orientation.

outputs.major_axis_azimuth_deg: deg clockwise from north in [0,180); null when isotropic

metrics.aggregation_domain: all active particles of one realization
metrics.normalization: eigenvalues in descending order (major first); isotropic (azimuth null) when major-minor <= max(1e-9*trace, 1e-12 km2), the floor absorbing coordinate roundoff of single points
metrics.degenerate: DEGENERATE/ZERO_TOTAL_WEIGHT; INTEGRITY_ERROR/NEGATIVE_EIGENVALUE when the minor eigenvalue is below -1e-12*trace (smaller negatives are f64 roundoff, set to 0 and flagged)

metrics.meaning: Radii about the weighted particle centroid containing the declared fractions of the particle weight.
metrics.aggregation_domain: all active particles of one realization
metrics.normalization: cumulative weight fraction
metrics.quantile_convention: metrics.weighted_quantiles: stable ascending sort of horizontal distance (ties keep input order), first index whose cumulative fraction reaches q, linear interpolation against the preceding entry; zero-weight particles are excluded before sorting; distances use metrics.local_tangent_offsets_km about the centroid of the same weighting

metrics.meaning: Weighted particle-height quantiles and derived spreads.
required_artifacts: particle heights with a declared vertical reference
metrics.aggregation_domain: all active particles of one realization
metrics.normalization: cumulative weight fraction
metrics.quantile_convention: metrics.weighted_quantiles (via metrics.vertical_quantiles semantics); zero-weight particles excluded. Differs from the runner cross-check convention metrics.unweighted_quantiles_linear, which is not a contract metric.

metrics.meaning: Fraction of particle weight in each declared output layer (bottom 0, OUTHEIGHTS tops, half-open [bottom, top)) plus the fraction at or above the top layer.
required_artifacts: case output_grid.heights_m with heights_ref equal to the particle vertical reference
metrics.aggregation_domain: all active particles of one realization
metrics.normalization: fractions of the total weight; layers need not be uniform
metrics.missing_data: MISSING_EVIDENCE/LAYER_GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE without declared layers; INCOMPATIBLE/VERTICAL_REFERENCE_MISMATCH when layer and particle references differ

metrics.meaning: Fraction of particle weight above the local mixing height (#64 fraction above BLH).
required_artifacts: per-particle mixing height at the particle position and output time
metrics.aggregation_domain: all active particles of one realization
metrics.normalization: fraction of total weight
metrics.missing_data: UNSUPPORTED/MIXING_HEIGHT_UNAVAILABLE: corpus seed files carry no per-particle mixing height and partposit hmix is not decoded; #64 owns adding attributable evidence

metrics.meaning: Cell-mass-weighted horizontal centroid of a gridded field using cell centers.
required_artifacts: gridded field with declared quantity, measure, unit, layout and grid geometry
metrics.aggregation_domain: full output grid (all levels for 3-D fields)
metrics.time_window: the field's declared window (time average or accumulation since start)
metrics.normalization: cell weights divided by their total; latitude-dependent cell areas
metrics.missing_data: MISSING_EVIDENCE/GRID_FIELD_UNAVAILABLE; INTEGRITY_ERROR/INCOMPLETE_FIELD for a wrong cell count or null cell

metrics.meaning: Cell-mass-weighted mean height of a 3-D field using layer midpoints between OUTHEIGHTS layer tops (bottom 0).
metrics.aggregation_domain: full 3-D output grid
metrics.normalization: cell weights divided by their total
metrics.missing_data: MISSING_EVIDENCE/VERTICAL_FIELD_UNAVAILABLE for surface fields; LAYER_GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE without OUTHEIGHTS

metrics.meaning: Cell-mass-weighted population covariance of column cell centers about the grid centroid.
metrics.aggregation_domain: full output grid, columns summed over levels
metrics.normalization: population convention; cell-center positions (sub-cell spread is not represented)
metrics.degenerate: DEGENERATE/ZERO_TOTAL_WEIGHT; one occupied cell gives an all-zero matrix (COMPUTED)

metrics.meaning: Eigen-decomposition of grid.horizontal.covariance.

outputs.major_axis_azimuth_deg: deg clockwise from north in [0,180); null when isotropic

metrics.aggregation_domain: full output grid
metrics.normalization: as particle.horizontal.principal_axes

metrics.meaning: Radii about the grid centroid containing the declared fractions of the cell-mass weight, using column cell centers.
metrics.aggregation_domain: full output grid, columns summed over levels
metrics.normalization: cumulative weight fraction; resolution limited to cell-center distances

metrics.meaning: Area of the smallest set of highest-surface-density columns holding the declared mass fraction (the #7 90% mass-footprint area). Threshold-free: no concentration cutoff.
metrics.aggregation_domain: full output grid, columns summed over levels
metrics.normalization: columns ranked by column mass / cell area descending, ties by ascending column index; whole cells only (no partial-cell interpolation)

metrics.meaning: Location of the column with the largest surface mass density and its share of the field mass.

outputs.tied_cells: number of columns sharing the maximum density

metrics.aggregation_domain: full output grid, columns summed over levels
metrics.normalization: density = column mass / cell area; ties resolve to the lowest column index and are counted

metrics.meaning: Fraction of the cell-mass weight in each output layer, using actual OUTHEIGHTS layer thicknesses.
metrics.aggregation_domain: full 3-D output grid
metrics.normalization: fractions of the total cell-mass weight (not of summed concentration; the legacy grid_metrics.vertical_profile concentration fractions are a different, superseded quantity)

metrics.meaning: Domain-integrated field mass in kg (sum of cell mass), only when the field declares a kilogram scale.
metrics.aggregation_domain: full output grid
metrics.normalization: none
metrics.missing_data: UNSUPPORTED/FIELD_MASS_SCALE_UNDECLARED when no kilogram scale is declared (FLEXPART binary grids: the 1e12 and sp_fact factors are not adopted by a versioned output contract, #40/#16)

metrics.meaning: Absolute candidate-minus-oracle comparison of aligned native field values: magnitude and pattern statements kept separate.

outputs.fractional_bias: 1 (Chang and Hanna 2004); null on non-positive denominator
outputs.nmse: 1 (Chang and Hanna 2004); null unless both means are positive

required_artifacts: candidate and oracle gridded fields of the same quantity, unit, species, window and grid
metrics.aggregation_domain: every cell of the identical output grid
metrics.normalization: none for bias/MAE/RMSE; NRMSE by max mean absolute value; NMSE by mean_o*mean_c
metrics.missing_data: MISSING_EVIDENCE when either field is absent; INCOMPATIBLE for any alignment, unit, species, window or transformation difference
metrics.degenerate: undefined sub-statistics are null with their reason in value.undefined; correlation of a constant field is null, never 1.0

metrics.meaning: Shape-only comparison of unit-sum cell-mass distributions. Says nothing about magnitude or mass conservation.
required_artifacts: candidate and oracle gridded fields of the same quantity, species, window and grid; units may differ only in scale
metrics.aggregation_domain: every cell of the identical output grid
metrics.normalization: each field's cell mass divided by its own total
metrics.degenerate: DEGENERATE/ZERO_TOTAL_WEIGHT when either field is all zero

metrics.meaning: Boolean cell-count overlap (Figure of Merit in Space) of the strictly positive supports. Sensitive to single-particle noise; the support threshold (value > 0) is the declared rule, not a tuned cutoff.

outputs.figure_of_merit_in_space: 1; null when the union is empty

metrics.aggregation_domain: every cell of the identical output grid
metrics.normalization: intersection / union cell counts
metrics.degenerate: DEGENERATE/EMPTY_FOOTPRINT when both supports are empty

metrics.meaning: Area-weighted intersection over union of the candidate and oracle mass-containment footprints (grid.horizontal.mass_footprint_area cell sets).
metrics.aggregation_domain: columns of the identical output grid
metrics.normalization: intersection area / union area
metrics.degenerate: DEGENERATE/ZERO_TOTAL_WEIGHT when either field is all zero

metrics.meaning: Horizontal distance between the candidate and oracle grid centroids.
metrics.aggregation_domain: identical output grid
metrics.normalization: equirectangular offsets at the oracle centroid latitude (the existing evaluator convention)
metrics.degenerate: DEGENERATE/ZERO_TOTAL_WEIGHT when either field is all zero

metrics.meaning: The #54 INV-MASS-CLOSURE kilogram budget of one realization, exposed under a stable metric identity. Read from the invariant record, never recomputed.
metrics.aggregation_domain: whole realization
metrics.normalization: relative error by initial mass (metrics.mass_budget)
metrics.missing_data: MISSING_EVIDENCE/MASS_LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE when the invariant has no measured ledger (FLEXPART 11.1 binary output, terminated particles)
metrics.degenerate: relative_error null for zero initial mass

metrics.meaning: Domain-total deposited mass of one reservoir (dry or wet) in kg from the #54 ledger.
required_artifacts: the artifact's own dry/wet reservoir ledger (deposited_dry_kg / deposited_wet_kg)
metrics.aggregation_domain: whole realization
metrics.normalization: none
metrics.missing_data: MISSING_EVIDENCE/DEPOSITION_RESERVOIR_UNAVAILABLE when the artifact carries no such reservoir; never inferred from particle mass disappearance
metrics.degenerate: a zero reservoir is a valid 0 (COMPUTED)
metrics.owner: scripts/evaluate/invariants.py (realization reservoirs as consumed by INV-MASS-CLOSURE)

#7.scientific_use: Horizontal turbulence / plume spread before and after gridding.
#7.required_artifacts: Candidate seed particles; oracle particle positions (partposit) for particle space; candidate and oracle grids on one OUTGRID for the 90% footprint area.
#7.units_domain: km / km2 in geographic local-tangent projection; whole domain.
#7.availability: Candidate particle metrics available (mass and count weighting). Oracle particle-space metrics only with a decoded partposit dump (count weighting). The #7 '90% footprint area after conservative regridding' is BLOCKED by REGRIDDING_UNAVAILABLE unless both grids are identical; corpus candidates write no grid.
#7.missing_evidence: Oracle partposit masses; candidate gridded corpus output; a conservative regridding contract.

#8.scientific_use: Baseline vertical transport and PBL regime (quantitative margins moved to #64).
#8.required_artifacts: Particle heights (AGL), case OUTHEIGHTS (AGL), per-particle mixing height for the BLH fraction.
#8.availability: Mean height, quantiles and layer fractions available for candidates and decoded oracle partposit (count weighting). Fraction above BLH UNSUPPORTED.

#13.scientific_use: Wet deposition reservoir and spatial field.
#13.required_artifacts: Candidate wet reservoir (deposited_wet_kg) and candidate wet-deposition grid; oracle grid_conc wet block.
#13.units_domain: kg (ledger); per-area accumulated since start (oracle field); surface grid.
#13.availability: Candidate reservoir total available when the seed file carries deposited_wet_kg. Oracle wet field shape/location metrics available; oracle kg total UNSUPPORTED (FIELD_MASS_SCALE_UNDECLARED). Candidate wet grid absent.
#13.missing_evidence: Candidate gridded wet deposition (#41/#42); oracle kg scale contract (#40).

#14.scientific_use: Dry deposition and settling reservoir and spatial field.
#14.required_artifacts: Candidate dry reservoir (deposited_dry_kg); oracle grid_conc dry block; candidate dry-deposition grid.
#14.units_domain: kg (ledger); per-area accumulated since start (oracle field); surface grid.
#14.availability: As #13 for dry deposition. Settling effects are visible through particle vertical metrics.
#14.missing_evidence: Candidate gridded dry deposition (#41/#42); oracle kg scale contract (#40). #114 deposition migration is not consumed here.

#16.scientific_use: Concentration and deposition output semantics and paired field parity.
#16.required_artifacts: Candidate and oracle gridded outputs with declared quantity, unit, species, window semantics and identical grids.
#16.units_domain: Declared field units; full output grid; declared window.
#16.availability: Unary oracle field metrics available. Absolute paired statistics are INCOMPATIBLE until both models write the same unit (#40); shape statistics need a PASS #54 gate and ELIGIBLE paired scoring.
#16.missing_evidence: Versioned scientific output schema (#40) and candidate serialization (#42).

downstream_handoff.per_realization_records: report.distributional_metrics.records: one record per (metric_id, realization or pair, weighting, quantity, parameters) with contract identity, realization/execution identity, case identity, comparability_key, status and eligible_for_paired_scoring. Consume via distributional.collect_for_ensemble, which also returns the #54 aggregate from invariants.aggregate_realizations.
downstream_handoff.#58: Group records by comparability_key and role. Candidate (Philox namespace) and oracle (FLEXPART internal seed namespace) realizations are independent samples; never pair them by seed_index. Use only records with eligible_for_paired_scoring true; report every other record's status. A #54 FAIL/INTEGRITY_ERROR/BLOCKED in any source report keeps collect_for_ensemble.eligible false.
downstream_handoff.#59: Reference metrics by metric_id + definition_version + output name; thresholds live in the owning physics issue or #43 pre-registration, never here.
downstream_handoff.not_provided: Ensemble execution, aggregation, confidence intervals, equivalence tests and verdicts.

unimplemented.blocker: partposit xmass decoding; FLEXPART 11.1 writes partposit as NetCDF only
corpus-run writes end-state particles only, no gridded output

change_policy: Any change to a metric's meaning, outputs, weighting, parameters, conventions or degenerate behavior increments that metric's version and the contract_version, and adds a mutation test. Adding a metric increments contract_version. Reports from different contract versions or digests are never aggregated (INCOMPATIBLE/CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH).
